task_definition.task_description: Please check the weather in Tokyo, turn the result into a short summary, create a weather alert card for Tokyo, and then publish that travel advisory to my app with high priority. After that, book flight AA100 in economy and a standard room at Tokyo Grand Hotel for Jordan Lee from 2026-01-20 to 2026-01-23, then scan my living room devices, find the smart lock and lock it with PIN 2026, check the living room light and set its brightness to 20, and finally save a note titled “Trip Preparation Summary” with the Tokyo weather summary tagged travel, weather, and home-prep.
